ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% high-intensity (white/light blue) pixels centrally with 15% low-intensity (black/dark) pixels concentrated at the margins and base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity central zone; low-intensity perimeter banding along the trailing edge and distal tips; dark vertical striae and irregular mottling clustered near the central peduncle attachment point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; narrow apex with an estimated interior angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous linear boundary; prominent jagged peaks and valleys with varying pixel-amplitudes, most visible on the mid-to-outer sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping convexity along the leading edges, tapering into sharp, upwardly-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of low-intensity focal spots (dark pixel clusters) located in the lower-left quadrant and mid-right lobe area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned vertical linear disruptions visible in the high-intensity lower central region near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular deep indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe; significant dark pigment saturation and mottling at the fluke base/peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive upward-curved 'hook' morphology at the lateral fluke tips.
